## Description

Add two CLI commands for token usage diagnostics, adapted from entireio/cli#1393. Users have no way to inspect how many tokens their sessions consume, which turns are most expensive, or where optimization opportunities exist. Token counts are already stored in `agent.SessionData` and `checkpoint.SessionMetadata`, but no command surfaces them.

## What to build

Add `partio session tokens [session-id]` and `partio checkpoint tokens <checkpoint-id>` commands.

`partio session tokens [session-id]`:
- Reports total token counts for a session (input, output, cache tokens where available)
- Shows a per-turn breakdown identifying which turns consumed the most tokens
- Gracefully handles sessions where token data is unavailable
- When no session-id is given, uses the most recent session

`partio checkpoint tokens <checkpoint-id>`:
- Reports token counts stored in checkpoint metadata (`SessionMetadata.TotalTokens`)
- Reads checkpoint data via `checkpoint.Read`

Both commands accept `--json` for machine-readable output.

Needs #223 first: the Claude parser declares `totalTokens` but never sets it (`internal/agent/claude/parse_jsonl.go:32`), so `TotalTokens` is 0 for Claude sessions. #223 extracts `message.usage` and counts each `message.id` once (one assistant message spans several JSONL entries that repeat the same usage). For the per-turn breakdown, keep the usage of each message in `Message.Tokens` (`internal/agent/types.go:23`). The Codex parser (`internal/agent/codex/parse_jsonl.go`) already reads `token_count` events.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `partio session tokens` displays aggregate token usage for a session
- [ ] `partio checkpoint tokens` displays token counts from checkpoint metadata
- [ ] Per-turn token counts are shown when parseable from the JSONL transcript
- [ ] `--json` flag produces machine-readable output on both commands
- [ ] Commands handle gracefully when token data is unavailable (zero counts, no crash)

## Premise

<!-- partio:premise:v1 -->

- `agent.SessionData` includes a `TotalTokens` field for aggregate session token counts [evidence: `internal/agent/types.go`]
- `checkpoint.SessionMetadata` includes a `TotalTokens` field for per-checkpoint token counts [evidence: `internal/checkpoint/metadata.go`]
- No `partio session tokens` or `partio checkpoint tokens` commands exist today [evidence: `cmd/partio/`]
